## Displaying Top-Level and Sub-Level Categories On The Homepage


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000021788

This guide demonstrates the setup utilizing the Streaming Top Categories widget. For displaying lower-tier categories on the homepage, select the Streaming Sub Level Categories widget instead. The configuration steps for both options remain identical. To display Top-Level Categories on the homepage, navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage tab >> Select Streaming Top Categories option under Select Content to Display section: Clicking on Edit Settings will display a module where this widget can be edited further: The next step would be adding related images to each categories. Navigation Path: My Members » Member Categories Image Requirement: Upload a specific image to each category row. Recommended Image Dimensions: 400px by 200px. Inside the Edit Settings module for the streaming widget, the visibility of the categories is determined by the following rule: Enabled ("Only Show Categories with Photos"): The homepage widget will automatically hide any category that lacks an uploaded image. Disabled ("Only Show Categories with Photos"): All selected categories will display on the homepage, regardless of whether a placeholder image has been uploaded.
